text: BELLHAVEN, March 18 — Varnholt Logistics appointed Ilse Marrenkamp as chief executive in March, people familiar with the matter said. Marrenkamp, who had served as the company’s chief operating officer since 2021, took over after the board voted unanimously to replace longtime CEO Daren Voss, according to the people. The privately held freight coordinator said in a brief internal notice that Marrenkamp would focus on network efficiency, fleet modernization and expansion across the North Marrow corridor. People familiar with the matter said the transition had been in planning since January and that deputy finance chief Rina Solt would oversee day-to-day operations until April. Varnholt declined to comment on the leadership change.
